people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.
translations.bsb: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I also prayed for Aaron.
translations.kjv: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
translations.asv: And Jehovah was very angry with Aaron to destroy him: and I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.
